Dataset description This study employed the UC Merced Land-Use Dataset as part of the Central dataset which is a standard benchmark in land-use classification studies. This dataset is sourced from the USA Geological Survey (USGS) and is available for public access at23. The dataset is well known to remote sensing researchers over the years due to its high resolution in aerial images, and clean-cut scene categorizations. The dataset includes a total of 21 unique land-use scene classes, each containing 100 images, amounting to 2100 labeled samples that extensively cover both urban and rural environments, making it very suitable for the evaluation of classification models under complex spatial patterns.
